# Configure Leaflet Layers (map layers & bundles)

No global settings form (`configure` null). Everything is done through two config entities under
**Structure › Leaflet Layers** (`/admin/structure/leaflet_layers`). Routes are generated by the
entity route providers; access = core `administer site configuration` (`admin_permission` on both
entities); the overview page requires `access administration pages`.

## Map layer (`map_layer`) — a single custom layer

Routes: collection `/admin/structure/leaflet_layers/map_layer`, add `.../map_layer/add`,
edit `.../map_layer/{map_layer}/edit`. Config name: `leaflet_layers.map_layer.<id>`.

Exported keys (`config_export`): `id`, `label`, `description`, `settings`. The form
(`MapLayerForm`) writes a `layer_type` (`base` | `overlay`) and the chosen plugin's settings into
`settings`, plus `settings.plugin_type` (the LayerType plugin id). Common `settings` keys come from
the plugin (see [../plugins/layer-type.md](../plugins/layer-type.md)):

| Key | From | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `plugin_type` | selector | `tilelayer` or `wms`. |
| `layer_type` | select | `base` or `overlay`. |
| `urlTemplate` | tilelayer | Tile URL (with `{x}/{y}/{z}`) or WMS URL. |
| `attribution` | tilelayer | Attribution HTML string. |
| `minZoom`/`maxZoom`/`zoomOffset` | tilelayer | Cast to int by `getSettings()`. |
| `opacity` | tilelayer | Cast to float. |
| `subdomains`/`errorTileUrl`/`tms`/`zoomReverse`/`detectRetina` | tilelayer | Leaflet TileLayer options. |
| `layers`/`styles`/`format`/`transparent`/`version`/`uppercase` | wms | Leaflet TileLayer.WMS options. |

## Map bundle (`map_bundle`) — an ordered group of layers

Routes: collection `/admin/structure/leaflet_layers/map_bundle`, add/edit/delete alongside.
Config name: `leaflet_layers.map_bundle.<id>`. Exported keys: `id`, `label`, `layers`, `settings`.

`MapBundleForm` lists every layer discovered from **all** `hook_leaflet_map_info()` implementations
(other modules) plus all custom `map_layer` entities, split into **Base layers** and **Overlay
layers** drag-tables. Per row you set: custom label, **Enabled**, **On by default** (overlays only),
and **Weight**. On save, `removeInactiveLayers()` drops unchecked rows and renormalizes weights;
each kept layer stores `{id,label,module,layer_id,map_bundle,enabled,on_by_default,weight}`.

`settings` is a map of boolean Leaflet map behavior toggles (all default TRUE):
`dragging`, `touchZoom`, `scrollWheelZoom`, `doubleClickZoom`, `zoomControl`, `attributionControl`,
`trackResize`, `fadeAnimation`, `zoomAnimation`, `closePopupOnClick`, `layerControl`.

## How a bundle reaches Leaflet

`leaflet_layers_leaflet_map_info()` (in `.module`) implements `hook_leaflet_map_info()`. For each
bundle it emits `['label','settings','layers','leaflet_layers'=>TRUE]`. For layers owned by other
modules it re-invokes that module's `hook_leaflet_map_info()` and copies the matching layer def; for
custom `map_layer` layers it builds `['urlTemplate'=>…, 'options'=>settings, 'type'=>plugin_type]`.
Layers are sorted so base layers precede overlays. Saving a layer or bundle invalidates the
`leaflet_map_info` cache. The Leaflet module then offers the bundle as a selectable map on its map
formatters/views.

## Drush / config example

```php
// Create a custom OSM tile layer, then a bundle that enables it as a base layer.
\Drupal::entityTypeManager()->getStorage('map_layer')->create([
  'id' => 'osm_custom', 'label' => 'OSM Custom',
  'settings' => [
    'plugin_type' => 'tilelayer', 'layer_type' => 'base',
    'urlTemplate' => 'https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png',
    'attribution' => '© OpenStreetMap', 'minZoom' => 0, 'maxZoom' => 19, 'opacity' => 1,
  ],
])->save();
```
